## What's new

Threadnote 5.4.3 improves Codex connection refreshes, preserves useful Context Brief evidence on large repositories, and makes PR watch recovery more reliable.

### Codex connections after an update

Install, update, and development activation reconcile managed Codex MCP entries with the active Threadnote release. An open Codex chat may still use its previous connection; Threadnote reports when a live refresh is pending and explains how to reconnect. Where a supported private Codex app-server socket is available, `threadnote repair --mcp codex` can request an owner-wide reload.

### Context Brief and recall

When scoped graph status times out on a large repository, Context Brief can retain a small amount of ready graph evidence marked stale. It withholds exact source excerpts and negative scope proof until freshness is verified. Recall also reports unconfirmed index maintenance consistently when combined reads have different outcomes.

### PR watch recovery

Queued notices can be drained after a watch stops, and an arrived notice can recover its original continuation after a PR head advances. Completion of retargeted PR stacks now verifies the recorded merge and any required maintenance validation. Unsupported Codex watch destinations receive guidance to start future watches from the owning top-level conversation.
